title: Build integrated capture page and application shell
description:
Create the CaptureViewModel C++ class, CapturePage QML component, and wire the application shell in Main.qml. This task integrates the source browser (f.1), waveform/meter (f.2), and settings (f.4) into the primary capture experience.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/ui/SourceListModel.hpp for model roles and Q_INVOKABLE methods created in f.1.
- src/ui/WaveformBridge.hpp for properties and snapshot slot created in f.2.
- src/ui/SettingsViewModel.hpp for settings properties created in f.4.
- qml/Main.qml for any existing structure (loader, stack, navigation).
- src/audio/CaptureSession.hpp for session state enum (Idle, Connecting, Capturing, Reconnecting, Stopped, Error) and start/stop interface.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
- src/ui/CaptureViewModel.hpp / .cpp: A QObject exposing capture state (idle/capturing/stopping), selected source, output path, format info, capture duration, integrity status, and start/stop Q_INVOKABLE methods. Connects to the engine layer via signals/slots. Exposes whether capture is native, quantized, resampled, or converted. Provides pre-roll/post-roll and auto-start/auto-stop property bindings.
- qml/pages/CapturePage.qml: Integrates SourceCard list (from SourceListModel), WaveformView, capture controls (start/stop/arm), status display (duration, format, integrity), and output destination selector. Must clearly distinguish application streams, system monitors, and hardware inputs visually.
- qml/Main.qml: Wire the application shell with navigation between CapturePage and SettingsPage using the context properties or singleton names registered by src/app/main.cpp; do not instantiate an unregistered C++ type from QML.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Bootstrap/build ownership: Before editing, inspect src/app/main.cpp for the actual Phase-A QQmlApplicationEngine context-property/singleton setup and the Phase-E CLI dispatch that must be preserved, and inspect CMakeLists.txt for the exact Phase-A source-list and qt_add_qml_module or qt_add_resources mechanism. In main.cpp, preserve CLI dispatch, instantiate CaptureViewModel, SourceListModel, WaveformBridge, and SettingsViewModel in the GUI bootstrap, expose them through that actual engine mechanism before loading QML, and wire non-realtime CaptureSession CaptureVisualizationSnapshot value copies to the WaveformBridge queued slot at a UI-friendly cadence. Main.qml consumes the registered names; QML must not construct an unregistered C++ type. In CMakeLists.txt, explicitly register every completed Phase B-F C++ source/header with abracapture and every completed Phase F QML file using the Phase-A mechanism. Do not use source-file globbing or create a second target/module.
acceptance_criteria: src/ui/CaptureViewModel.hpp and src/ui/CaptureViewModel.cpp exist and define a QObject subclass with Q_PROPERTYs for captureState, selectedSourceId, outputPath, formatDescription, durationSeconds, and integrityStatus
CaptureViewModel exposes a Q_PROPERTY or Q_INVOKABLE indicating whether capture is native, quantized, resampled, or converted
qml/pages/CapturePage.qml exists and references SourceListModel, WaveformView, and CaptureViewModel
qml/Main.qml provides navigation between CapturePage and SettingsPage and instantiates or references the four view models/bridges
CaptureViewModel does not perform file I/O, compression, or PipeWire calls directly
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
src/app/main.cpp preserves CLI dispatch and exposes all four Phase F C++ objects through the actual Phase-A QQmlApplicationEngine registration mechanism before qml/Main.qml loads
CMakeLists.txt explicitly registers completed Phase B-F C++ sources with abracapture and completed Phase F QML files through the Phase-A QML mechanism, without globbing
The configured abracapture target builds in RelWithDebInfo after the Phase F fan-in
forbidden_changes: modify any file under src/pipewire/ or src/engine/
perform file I/O or compression in the view model

allowed: choose how to expose integrity status (enum, string, structured object)
add local helpers for duration formatting
forbidden: introduce a plugin host, timeline editor, or DAW features
add direct PipeWire dependencies to UI layer
